🧠 Crypto News Brief: Markets held their breath as a hawkish Fed pause pinned Bitcoin near $64K and left Ether sliding. Fresh hacks and a stalling CLARITY Act kept sentiment in fear — even as Wall Street and travel giants deepened crypto adoption. 🏦 Hawkish Fed Hold Pins Bitcoin Near $64K The FOMC held rates at 3.50–3.75% in a rare 9-3 vote on July 29, with three regional presidents dissenting toward a hike — the first triple hawkish split since 2016. Bitcoin briefly touched $64,700 before fading to around $64,000, as roughly $300 million in leveraged positions were liquidated across tens of thousands of traders. Read full story → 📊 Bitcoin ETFs Flip Green as Ether Funds Bleed US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $32.1 million in net inflows on July 29, snapping a four-day outflow streak, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $89.8 million. Spot Ether ETFs slipped into net outflows on the same day, underscoring a capital rotation back toward Bitcoin and Ethereum's fading market dominance. More details → 🏛️ CLARITY Act Stalls as Senate Misses Recess Deadline Prediction-market odds on the CLARITY Act passing crashed to around 28% after the Senate missed its August-recess deadline, leaving the crypto market-structure bill in limbo. Prolonged gridlock could push the SEC to write securities-side rules on its own while lawmakers keep debating how to split oversight with the CFTC. Read more → 🔓 Ostium Post-Mortem Confirms $23.75M Off-Chain Breach Arbitrum perpetuals exchange Ostium published its post-mortem confirming attackers drained $23.75 million in USDC from its liquidity vault via a compromised off-chain oracle signer — not a smart-contract flaw. Trader collateral was untouched, trading resumed July 23, and a recovery plan for liquidity providers is being finalized. See details → ⚠️ Senator Lummis' X Account Hacked to Push Scam Token Hackers briefly seized Senator Cynthia Lummis' verified X account on July 29, posting a fake "$USA Token" Solana meme coin through a pump.fun link before the messages were deleted within minutes. Lummis is the Senate's most vocal CLARITY Act advocate, making the timing of the takeover especially pointed. Read full story → 💼 Morgan Stanley Launches Staked Ether and Solana ETPs Morgan Stanley Investment Management listed staked Ethereum (MSSE) and Solana (MSOL) exchange-traded products on NYSE Arca, each charging 0.14% and passing staking
